title: 2-3 years
content: I have been having the Mall World dream for about 2 to 3 years. The thing that I find interesting is that if I am dreaming of being in a given building, it turns into a mall. Casino? Turns into a mall. Restaurant? Turns into a mall. When I am finally in the mall, I feel like I am shopping for something really important, although I don't necessary know what it is. &#x200B; [Here's my childhood mall in New Jersey. ](https://preview.redd.it/pizo65i33s1a1.jpg?width=1197&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=9b9a89c8a1e9914c331fa39ddcb5d77ed64302ff)
